prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic raw bedroom mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with kawaii styling.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult Japanese woman with light chestnut loose waves, cute hair clips, doe eyes, natural blush, soft full lips, and a shy playful smile, wearing an opaque pastel-blue hoodie, opaque white knee-length skirt, and fluffy white socks.
prompt.composition_elements: Comfortably seated on the bed while holding a white phone, soft head tilt, cream bedding, heart-shaped pillows, pink ambient light, cozy cute Japanese bedroom, natural proportions.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft indoor ambient light with vintage film glow, pastel pink illumination, cozy sweet dreamy atmosphere, realistic unfiltered smartphone texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic iPhone 15 Pro Max selfie, 8K-style detail, sharp focus, natural skin, subtle film grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-photorealistic raw 8K iPhone 15 Pro Max mirror selfie of an approved adult Japanese woman with light chestnut-brown loose waves, cute hair clips, large sparkling eyes, soft full lips, natural blush, and a shy playful smile. She wears an opaque pastel-blue hoodie, an opaque white knee-length skirt, and fluffy white socks, seated comfortably on a bed while holding a white phone with a gentle head tilt. The cute Japanese bedroom has cream bedding, heart-shaped pillows, soft pink lighting, and a cozy dreamy kawaii atmosphere. Keep realistic proportions, natural skin, sharp focus, and subtle vintage film glow.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, girl/minor wording, cropped hoodie, mini skirt, exposed thighs emphasis, lingerie, sexualized kneeling pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
